brief: The canvas displays luminous streams of data flowing through a dark, subterranean void. These streams organize into tightly defined, crystalline ribbons of light that follow large, looping helical patterns. The collective movement is highly rhythmic, initiating as a harmonic pulsation where the light sequentially brightens and dims along the ribbon's length. This pulsating movement resolves over time into distinct, sharp geometrical nodes at every intersection point, stabilizing the entire field of light within the void.
